metadata.verdict_rule: The verdict applies only to the registered statement: the share of CISI-trained INITIAL signs meeting the Harappa start-rate bar, on the withheld Harappa data.
metadata.boundary_confirmation: C01 bounds what a verdict MEANS; C02 fixes the criterion the verdict applies; C08 fixes the computation that produces the share. metadata.verdict_rule: CONFIRMED exactly when the computed share is at least 70 percent; NOT CONFIRMED below it; no other verdict wording exists under this spec.
